meta_description: Curletts Decorating Services in Liverpool offers interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and full redecoration. Local, reliable, competitive rates. Call today.
hero_subhead: From feature walls to full room transformations, we deliver pristine finishes on time and within budget.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Liverpool
services_subhead: Whether you need a quick refresh or a full interior overhaul, we handle every aspect of domestic and commercial decoration.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Transform any room with expert interior painting, including prep work, undercoat, and finish coat. We use premium paints and deliver smooth, long-lasting results.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Protect and enhance your home's exterior with professional external painting. We prepare surfaces thoroughly and use weatherproof finishes that last years.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Hang patterned, textured, or feature wallpapers with precision alignment and seamless joins. Includes wall prep and expert finishing touches.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Create striking focal points with bold colours or textured finishes. We'll help you choose the right shade and execute flawless application.

services.title: Woodwork & Skirting Boards
services.desc: Paint doors, skirting boards, architrave, and other woodwork to a professional standard. Includes sanding, priming, and hard-wearing gloss or satin finishes.

services.title: Commercial & Office Redecorating
services.desc: Keep disruption minimal with flexible scheduling for shops, offices, and small commercial spaces. We work efficiently without compromising on quality.

about_pullquote: I started Curletts because every home deserves a fresh coat applied properly.
about_para_1: Curletts Decorating Services was founded 15 years ago on a simple principle: turn any room around with meticulous preparation, quality materials, and skilled application. Based in Anfield, we've built our reputation by showing up on time, finishing on budget, and treating every job—whether a single bedroom or a full commercial refit—with the same care and attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers return because they know exactly what they'll get: no hidden costs, no surprises, and walls that look freshly done for years to come. We listen to what you want, offer honest advice on colour and finish, and do the work properly the first time. That's earned us a loyal base across Liverpool and beyond.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had Curletts in to do our lounge and hallway. The lads were tidy, professional, and finished a day early. Colour advice was spot on. Really pleased with the finish. Would have them back tomorrow.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Needed our exterior painted before winter. They prepped everything properly, no rushing. Paint's holding up brilliantly, even in the rain. Fair price too. Top job.
reviews.author: Christine W.

reviews.text: Feature wall in our kitchen was exactly what I'd imagined. They helped me pick the right shade and the application is immaculate. Friendly crew, tidy workers. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David K.
